snippet.title: War in Spain 1936-39 | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
War in Spain 1936–39 is out now and marks the debut of a new series of strategic wargames.
Built on a new Land–Sea–Air engine inspired by War in the Pacific – Admiral’s Edition, the game delivers a deep and historically grounded simulation of the Spanish Civil War.
This gameplay trailer showcases the core mechanics, including the command of land, naval, and air forces, operational planning, and the strategic depth that defines the experience.

Ⓜ️ Buy the game on Matrix ➡️ https://www.matrixgames.com/game/war-in-spain-1936-39
